newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine December foreign trade $21 mln surplus.
newsitem.headline: Argentine December foreign trade $21 mln surplus.

text.p: Argentina registered a $21 million foreign trade surplus in December and a $71 million surplus in 1996, the Economy Ministry announced Thursday.
The year's surplus compared with a $839 million surplus in 1995. No comparative figure was available for December 1995.
An Economy Ministry document later released indicated there was a surplus in December 1995 of $70 million.
Argentine exports totalled $23.8 billion in 1996, up 14 percent from 1995. Imports were $23.7 billion, up 18 percent from a year earlier, the ministry said.
Total trade hit a record figure of $47.6 billion, up 16 percent from 1995.
